checked_claims.note: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 gives deg(O_X(1)|_C)=2(2g-2+8)/2=2g+6=18. Hypothesis (N) writes the same bundle as omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2) tensor gamma^*A, of degree 18+4deg(A). Hence deg(A)=0 and Pic(P1)=Z forces A trivial. Substituting the packet convention W_f=(O_X(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C into the canonical HN filtration yields W_4=omega_C^2, W_5=omega_C^2(-D), L=omega_C(-D), with degrees 20, 16, 6 and chi(L)=1. The residual Pic(S) ambiguity of O_P(1) disappears on geometric fibres.

If C is hyperelliptic, (h,gamma):C->P1xP1 is either birational onto a (4,2)-curve of arithmetic genus 3, contradicting g=6, or of degree exactly 2 onto a (2,1)-curve, hence gamma=q o h with deg(q)=2. Then h_*O=O\oplus O(-7) and q_*O(-7)=O(-4)\oplus O(-4), so E=O(1)\oplus O(4)^2. The CE resolution tensored by O_X(2) pushes to 0->F->Sym^2 E->gamma_*(O_X(2)|_C)->0 because Rp_*O_X(-2)=0 on P2-fibres. Twisting by O(-6) gives h^0(Sym^2 E(-6))=9 against h^0(W_6)=7 (deg W_6=12>10), so h^0(F(-6))>=2, contradicting F(-6)=O(-2)\oplus O(-1). Characteristic zero is used only to keep the cover separable. The argument never claims anything about non-primitive pencils through positive-genus intermediate curves.

gamma^* injects H^0(O_{P1}(1)), so h^0(D)>=2. Riemann-Roch on D reads h^0(L)=h^0(D)+1, and chi(L)=1 makes D special. Clifford then gives h^0(D)<=3, with equality only for D=0, D=K, or hyperelliptic equality; the first two are excluded by deg(D)=4 and the third by CLM-0088-2. Thus h^0(D)=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2 on every balanced+(N) fibre, with no jumping. The projection formula then forces h^0(E^vee(1))=0, so every summand of E has degree at least two. Constancy is obtained by excluding only the hyperelliptic equality case, which is the correct direction of the recorded non-equivalence with exclusion of all non-primitive g^1_4's.

If the fixed part had degree >=2 the moving part A would be a base-point-free special g^2_{<=4}. Clifford forces deg(A)=4 with equality, hence C hyperelliptic, contradicting CLM-0088-2. So the fixed part has degree at most one (hence is reduced) and A is base-point-free of degree 5 or 6 with three sections. No claim is made that L itself is base-point-free.

The two-jet incidence J over the bpf moving part has dimension at most one after splitting off the finite ramification locus of psi:C->P2 (in characteristic zero a non-constant morphism of smooth curves is generically immersive). Its proper image therefore cannot fill the plane |A|, so a general member of |A| is reduced; removing in addition the hyperplane through the at most one fixed point yields a reduced six-point member of |L|. Separately h^0(L(-2q))>=1 for every q, so the corresponding incidence J_L surjects onto C, has dimension exactly one, and has finite fibres over |L| (a degree-six divisor has at most three points of multiplicity >=2). Thus Delta is a nonempty proper closed curve, |L|^red is a nonempty dense non-closed surface open, and ordering its universal divisor is a finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 720, smooth of pure dimension two. The construction lives in Conf_6(C), not on coarse M_{6,6}.

On B=Conf_6 the ATT-0065 disjoint-section hypotheses hold, with d_4-n=14>10 and d_5-n=10. CLM-0065-1 gives ranks 26 and 12 and Fit_0=I_12. CLM-0065-3 identifies coker(phi) with R^1 pi_*(W_5(-Gamma)), whose geometric fibres are Serre-dual to H^0 of a degree-zero line bundle and hence of dimension 0 or 1; the degree-zero section criterion is effectivity, not duality. Empty support of V(I_11) forces I_11=O_B as an ideal sheaf on any scheme, and the minor ideals decrease, so I_j=O_B for j<=11. The Fitting identity I_12=a_N^*I_e with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change is CLM-0065-4 (CLM-0065-9 supplies the same identity on the balanced (6,6) specialisation).

The displayed determinantal numbers (26-11)(12-11)=15 and (11-5)(6-5)=6, the fibre dimension 2 inside relative Conf_6 of dimension 6, and the equality 6-4=2=h^1(L) are correct bookkeeping. The artifact draws no regularity, depth, lci, Gysin, or Tate conclusion from the excess identity.

Constant h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2 on a reduced locally Noetherian base give, by Grauert, that pi_*L and R^1 pi_*L are locally free of ranks 3 and 2 and commute with base change. P_S(pi_*L) represents relative degree-six divisors with O(Gamma) isomorphic to L tensor a pullback: a fibrewise-nonzero map of a line bundle into a vector bundle over an arbitrary (possibly nonreduced) T is a line subbundle because the three local coordinates generate the unit ideal. U is the etale-support open of the universal divisor; fibrewise it equals |L|^red, hence is nonempty of pure dimension two by CLM-0088-5, so U->S is smooth of pure relative dimension two and surjective. Ordering is applied to the same unreduced scheme on both sides. Functors of points over arbitrary locally Noetherian T identify Ord(U) with Z, because every Conf_6-point already has etale support. Flatness of Z->S plus going-down and the dimension formula over a finite-type k-scheme give the component clause.

Z is closed in B by the Fitting presentation. Both Z and Conf_6 are smooth over the reduced base, of relative dimensions 2 and 6. A closed immersion of S-smooth schemes is a regular immersion, the conormal sheaf is locally free of rank equal to the relative-dimension difference, and the conormal sequence is exact and locally split. No inference is drawn from expected-versus-actual determinantal codimension.

Gamma is a disjoint union of sections, so T_{B/S}=pi_*O_Gamma(Gamma) and coker(delta)=R^1 pi_*O(Gamma) on B. Top cohomology of a relative curve commutes with arbitrary base change, so restriction to Z identifies this cokernel with R^1 pi_*(L tensor pi^*M_univ)=(R^1 pi_*L) tensor M_univ, locally free of rank two. The resulting map of bundles T_B|_Z->(R^1 O)|_Z therefore has locally free kernel and image of ranks 2 and 4. Fibrewise the kernel is the tangent space to the Abel-Jacobi fibre, hence equals T_{Z/S} after the etale ordering; the composite T_{Z/S}->(R^1 O)|_Z is a map of vector bundles vanishing at every geometric point of the reduced scheme Z, hence is zero. Two locally free rank-two subsheaves of T_B|_Z, one a subbundle, with torsion quotient inside the locally free conormal, must coincide. Relative duality dualizes 0->N_{Z/B}->(R^1 O)|_Z->Exc->0 to the displayed conormal sequence and retains the M_univ twist.

The naive bound dim J <= dim C + 1 = 2 is incorrect, but the proof does not use it. It splits J into a zero-dimensional-fibre piece over the complement of the finite ramification locus and a P^{<=1}-fibre piece over that finite set, each of dimension at most one. Characteristic zero is essential for finiteness of ramification.

Part III assumes S reduced exactly so that constant fibre dimensions h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2 yield local freeness and base change. No local-freeness, projective-bundle, smoothness, regular-immersion, or excess claim is made over a nonreduced base.

The attempt uses W_f=(O_X(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C throughout, matching the degree formula deg=4g+12-4f in SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (whose displayed definition W_fi=O(2) tensor gamma^*O(+fi) is the inconsistent sign the packet already flags). The unused surjectivity clause of Lemma 10.6 is not invoked.

finding_candidates.statement: On every geometric fibre of a genus-6 Casnati-Ekedahl family with balanced relations bundle F=O(4)+O(5) and weak relative-canonical normalization O_X(1)|_C isomorphic to omega_{C/P1} tensor gamma^*A, the linear system |L| with L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} has fixed part of degree at most one, the moving part is a base-point-free g^2_5 or g^2_6, a general member is a reduced six-point divisor, the non-reduced locus is a nonempty proper closed curve in the plane |L|, and the ordered Conf_6 incidence is a nonempty smooth finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 720 over that dense non-closed surface open. The argument does not assume that L itself is base-point-free.

Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced+(N) genus-6 family, the evaluation-failure scheme Z inside Conf_6(C/S) is S-smooth of pure relative dimension two (via the identification of Z with the S_6-torsor of orderings of the reduced-support open of P_S(pi_*L)), and the closed immersion Z->Conf_6 is therefore a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free conormal of rank four and a locally split conormal sequence. The lci conclusion is obtained from S-smoothness of both schemes, not from the excess of actual codimension 4 over the filtered determinantal expectation 6.

Under (CE)+(BAL)+(N), every geometric fibre has h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2. The only Clifford-equality case that could produce h^0(D)=3 is a hyperelliptic fibre, and a hyperelliptic genus-6 degree-four cover cannot have F=O(4)+O(5). Constancy on the balanced locus therefore uses only exclusion of the hyperelliptic-composed pencil; it is not equivalent to exclusion of every non-primitive degree-four pencil through a positive-genus intermediate curve.

On the ordered etale incidence Z, coker of the relative Abel-Jacobi differential is canonically (R^1 pi_*L) tensor M_univ, locally free of rank two, and the dual sequence realises the conormal of Z as the rank-four quotient of the Hodge bundle by pi_*(omega tensor L^vee) tensor M_univ^{-1}. Geometric fibres become abstractly isomorphic to H^1(L) only after trivialising the one-dimensional M_univ fibre.

For the filtered balanced CE evaluation at (g,n)=(6,6) on Conf_6, every geometric fibre has rank(phi) in {11,12}, so I_11(phi)=O_B as an ideal sheaf on any locally Noetherian base and I_j(phi)=O_B for all j<=11.

A hyperelliptic genus-6 degree-four cover necessarily factors as q o h, has Tschirnhausen bundle E=O(1)+O(4)+O(4), and cannot have balanced relations bundle F=O(4)+O(5): after twisting the CE quadric sequence by O(-6) one has h^0(F(-6))>=2, while balanced F gives h^0(F(-6))=0.

Granting only the weak CE relative-canonical normalization O_X(1)|_C isomorphic to omega_{C/P1} tensor gamma^*A, the degree computation deg(O_X(1)|_C)=18=18+4deg(A) forces A trivial on P1, hence W_5 isomorphic to omega_C^2(-D) and L isomorphic to omega_C(-D) on every balanced geometric fibre.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the two-jet incidence J subset C x |A| used to produce a reduced member of |L| on every balanced+(N) fibre has, a priori, fibre dimension at most 1 over a one-dimensional base, hence dimension at most 2, which would allow its image to fill the plane |A| and would leave the reduced-support open (and the ordered Conf_6 incidence) possibly empty on special fibres. That is exactly the obstruction recorded against inferring nonemptiness from chi(L)=1 alone. The attack fails because the proof splits J along the ramification locus R of the morphism psi:C->P2 defined by the base-point-free moving part: in characteristic zero a non-constant map of smooth curves is generically immersive, so R is finite; over C minus R the fibres of J are zero-dimensional, and over R they are at most P1, whence dim J<=1 and pr_2(J) cannot fill |A|. The residual hyperplane through an at-most-degree-one fixed part is likewise proper because the moving part is base-point-free. The same split, plus h^0(L(-2q))>=1, pins dim Delta=1. Runner-up attack: restriction of coker(delta)=R^1 pi_*O(Gamma) from Conf_6 to Z need not equal R^1 of O(Gamma)|_{C_Z} because h^0(O(Gamma)) jumps on Conf_6. That attack fails because R^1 of a flat sheaf on a relative curve is top cohomology and commutes with arbitrary base change, so Exc=(R^1 pi_*L) tensor M_univ is honest as a bundle and the tautological twist is retained. No stack-versus-coarse, rational-versus-integral, Poincare-twist, Gysin, spectral-sequence, invariants-versus-coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted-motive, or omitted-stable-pair error is load-bearing: the theorem is a scheme-level lemma over Conf_6 and expressly excludes M_{6,6} images, Hodge/Tate type, unbalanced strata, and nonreduced bases in Part III.
theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, S a locally Noetherian k-scheme, pi:C->S smooth and proper with geometrically connected genus-six fibres, s:P->S a P1-bundle, gamma:C->P finite flat of degree four with Tschirnhausen bundle E (gamma_*O_C = O_P direct-sum E^vee, E of rank three), p:X=P_P(E^vee)->P the associated P2-bundle in the packet convention p_*O_X(1)=E, i:C->X the Casnati-Ekedahl embedding, and F a rank-two bundle on P. Assume: (CE) the ideal of i has the standard degree-four CE resolution 0->O_X(-4) tensor p^*det(F)->O_X(-2) tensor p^*F->I_C->0; (BAL) F restricted to every geometric fibre of s is O(4) direct-sum O(5); (N) on every geometric fibre, O_X(1)|_C is isomorphic to omega_{C/P1} tensor gamma^*A for some A in Pic(P1). Put W=i^*(O_X(2) tensor p^*F^vee) with the canonical filtration 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 induced by the O(5)-subbundle of F, L=W_5 tensor omega_{C/S}^{-1}, D=gamma^*O_P(1); O_P(1), hence W_4,W_5,L,D, is well defined only up to twist by a line bundle pulled back from S, and every assertion below is invariant under such a twist. THEN: (I) On every geometric fibre: (I.1) A is trivial, W_5=omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), L=omega_C(-D), deg(L)=6, chi(L)=1, deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16; (I.2) C is not hyperelliptic; (I.3) h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2, so |L| is a projective plane, and every summand of E has degree at least two; (I.4) the fixed part of |L| has degree at most one, hence is reduced, and the moving part is base-point-free with three sections; (I.5) the non-reduced locus Delta in |L| is closed of dimension exactly one, so the reduced-support locus |L|^red = |L| minus Delta is a nonempty dense open subset of dimension two and is not closed in |L|; (I.6) the ordered incidence {(p_1,...,p_6) in C^6 pairwise distinct with p_1+...+p_6 in |L|} is nonempty, smooth of pure dimension two, and a finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 720 over |L|^red. (II) Let B=Conf_6(C/S) be the complement of the big diagonal in the six-fold fibre product, with its six tautological pairwise-disjoint sections, universal divisor Gamma, evaluation phi:pi_*W->pi_*(W|Gamma), N=omega_{C/S} tensor W_5^vee(Gamma), a_N:B->Pic^0_{C_B/B} and identity section e. Then pi_*W and pi_*(W|Gamma) are locally free of ranks 26 and 12, every geometric fibre of phi has rank 11 or 12, and: (II.1) I_j(phi)=O_B for every j<=11, while I_12(phi)=Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e cuts out the closed subscheme Z=a_N^{-1}(e(B)), whose formation commutes with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change; (II.2) the naive maximal-minor expectation for a 26-to-12 map is codimension 15 and the filtered 11-to-6 expectation is codimension 6, whereas the geometric fibres of Z->S have pure dimension two, i.e. codimension four in the fibres of B->S, the excess being 6-4=2=h^1(L). (III) Assume in addition S reduced. Then pi_*L is locally free of rank three, AJ=P_S(pi_*L) is a Zariski-locally trivial P2-bundle carrying a universal relative degree-six divisor, its etale locus U (the reduced-support open) is S-smooth of pure relative dimension two and surjective onto S, and the S_6-torsor of orderings of the universal divisor over U is canonically isomorphic to Z. Consequently: (III.1) Z->S is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two; if moreover S is of finite type over k, every irreducible component of Z and of U dominates an irreducible component of S and has dimension equal to the dimension of that component plus two; (III.2) the closed immersion Z->B is a regular immersion of pure codimension four, its conormal sheaf I_Z/I_Z^2 is locally free of rank four, and the conormal sequence 0->I_Z/I_Z^2->Omega_{B/S}|_Z->Omega_{Z/S}->0 is exact and locally split; (III.3) with delta:T_{B/S}=pi_*O_Gamma(Gamma)->R^1pi_*O_C the connecting map of 0->O_C->O_C(Gamma)->O_Gamma(Gamma)->0, the sequence 0->T_{Z/S}->T_{B/S}|_Z->(R^1pi_*O_C)|_Z->Exc->0 is exact on Z with Exc=coker(delta)|_Z canonically isomorphic to (R^1pi_*L) tensor M_univ, locally free of rank two, where M_univ is the tautological line bundle on Z determined by O(Gamma)=L tensor pi^*M_univ; dually 0->Exc^vee->(pi_*omega_{C/S})|_Z->I_Z/I_Z^2->0 is exact with Exc^vee = pi_*(omega_{C/S} tensor L^vee) tensor M_univ^{-1}, whose fibres are the two-dimensional spaces H^0(C,O_C(D)) of the tetragonal pencils. No assertion is made about images, closure, components, stabilizers, purity, codimension or Gysin maps in M_{6,6}, about unbalanced splitting types or h^0-jumping strata, about nonreduced bases in Part III, or about Hodge, weight or Tate type.
